decision: Not registered. Root PM assigns the experiment ID and registers rules before any real-data fit or scoring.
frontier_row: E1 (docs/reviews/PM-research-frontier-2026-10-03.md): direct-head backbone flatten MLP -> ResNet-style MLP
hypothesis: The direct pre-pitch head with a residual LayerNorm MLP backbone predicts the 2025 Cpanel DEV outcome distribution differently from the frozen flatten-MLP EXP-P15-001 head, alone and in the fixed 1/2 mix with G0-global.
one_change: Backbone architecture family only: flatten_mlp (Linear 286-256, GELU, Linear 256-256, GELU, Linear 256-10) -> residual MLP (see candidate_architecture). Inputs with current-pitch physics zero, 10 outcomes, optimizer AdamW wd .01, budget, unweighted May 1-15 early stop, May 16-31 Cpanel temperature, June Cpanel frequency blend, Cpanel DEV and frozen whole-MLB DEV are EXP-P15-001. Shape, normalization, dropout and depth change together as one disclosed architecture factor.

literature.source: Gorishniy, Rubachev, Khrulkov, Babenko 2021, Revisiting Deep Learning Models for Tabular Data
literature.fidelity: Adaptation, not a faithful replication: our flattened token/mask/context input, ten-class head, GELU instead of ReLU (kept equal to the control), single hidden dropout, no residual dropout, no per-feature preprocessing, no HPO. Third-party code not fetched or used.

candidate_architecture.fit_procedure: pitchmdp/direct_residual_model.py DirectResidualModel.fit mirrors MatrixModel.fit (torch branch); equivalence with the flatten_mlp network tested

future_confirmation: Seeds 3 and 4 only in a separate registered confirmation after root review. Equal-parameter wide-MLP control only as a follow-up if E1 is not inconclusive (capacity vs structure).

mix.rule: candidate direct head and the frozen G0-global member of the same seed, member-wise 1/2, then the same June frequency blend; compared with the frozen G15 mix (EXP-P15-002 construction) of the same seeds

device: --device auto (default) = mps if available else cpu, the control rule. Explicit cpu/cuda is recorded in identity and preparation (comparable_device_to_control false for cpu/cuda); such scores are not comparable to the MPS control without a same-device control arm. No newsrv/GPU use for this family.
data_rules: No 2026 rows (runner date guard). TRAIN rows only for fitting; May/June Cpanel rows only for early stop, temperature and blend; DEV never used for fitting, calibration or selection.

metrics.primary_descriptive: Cpanel DEV after the June frequency blend: candidate direct vs frozen uniform direct, and candidate mix vs frozen G15 mix, paired NLL/Brier with whole-game bootstrap, per-seed deltas
secondary_descriptive: Cpanel DEV before the frequency blend
whole-MLB DEV calibrated three-seed mean (no June blend) when --mlb was run
parameter counts, best epoch and fit/predict seconds per seed

exposure_note: Cpanel and whole-MLB DEV were read repeatedly (P7-003, P11, P13-P16, P20 pending). Results are development comparisons, not confirmation.

order: score: --output <runs>/<registered id> score   (only after all 3 fits; writes analysis/descriptive.json only)
execution.queue: single heavy queue runs/ML-MATRIX-20260924/.heavy.lock; Mac mini MPS only; never concurrently with EXP-P20-001
execution.expected_cost: 미측정 (unknown until smoke). Residual network has 1.20x the control parameters; control EXP-P15-001 seed 0 reference: fit 70.3 s, Cpanel predict 7.2 s, whole-MLB 1-draw predict 123.4 s.
